snippet.title: DISEMBODIED - RELEASE DATE - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Disembodied is coming to Quest 3/3s October 15th. Wishlist Now! Disembodied is a mixed reality platformer that turns your real hand movements into precise, physics-driven gameplay, taking hand tracking to a whole new level.
